mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering a 60-day S&P 500 sell-off as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing supply chain disruptions reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained real personal consumption growth (RSAFS above 12-month moving average) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.2 percentage points monthly) signals impending monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market slowdown, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) during monetary tightening cycles increase borrowing costs and reduce liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
